A prompt pack for AI agents

Design Partner Prompts

Give these to your AI agent and it works like a design partner. It interviews you about the app you want, sketches layouts with you, writes down what to build, and then builds it.

The process: understand the work first, sketch early, be honest about what's real, prove the risky parts before building on them, and leave the decisions to you.

View the files on GitHub

How a session goes

  1. 1DiscoverAn interview about who it's for, how they work today and what must be on screen. Bring sketches and screenshots.
  2. 2SketchTwo or three different layouts as wireframes. Pick one, mix them, or mark one up.
  3. 3DefineResearch notes, numbered requirements and a build plan with a demo script.
  4. 4BuildA feasibility check first, then small milestones you can click through.
  5. 5ReviewYou run the demo yourself. It's done when you say yes.

You choose how deep to go

The agent asks at the start. You can change it at any time.

Quick

~10 min · ~5 questions

One layout sketch and a one-page plan, then build. For when you already know what you want.

Standard

~30 min · ~15 questions

One round of layout options, a short requirements doc, then build in milestones.

Deep

1 hr+ · can span sessions

A full co-design interview, several sketch rounds, a research report and a full plan before any code.

Steer it whenever you like

faster
Finish this phase now. Gaps get sensible defaults, written down so you can check them.
deeper
Spend more time on the current topic.
show me
Sketch the current idea right away.
just build it
Jump to building, after one short list of assumptions you can correct.
go back
Reopen an earlier decision.
where are we?
What's decided, what's assumed and what comes next.

How to use it

In a coding agent

Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar.

  1. Make an empty folder for your app.
  2. Put the prompt files in it as a design-partner/ folder: git clone https://github.com/nikmart/design-partner-prompts design-partner, or Code → Download ZIP on GitHub.
  3. Start your agent there and say: "Read design-partner/designer.md and follow it. Let's design an app."

In a chat assistant

claude.ai, ChatGPT or similar.

  1. Copy the all-in-one prompt and paste it as your first message, or into a project's instructions.
  2. You get the interview, sketches and a finished plan.
  3. Take the plan to a coding agent to build it.

Everything is saved in a design/ folder, so a later session picks up where you left off. The builder uses Next.js, shadcn/ui and the Vercel AI SDK, with Claude, OpenAI or a free local model through Ollama. Put API keys in .env.local, never in the chat; the agent asks before anything leaves your computer or costs money.
